name: Yuwang
quote: To watch a miracle of science struggle free of the shackles of gravity, and trace a perfect orbit across the firmament.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning, Professor. Have you had breakfast yet? I brought an extra portion for you. That said, I favor hot food in the mornings, which might be at odds with... What's that? The Oasis is overflowing with baozi?

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Have you taken an afternoon nap, Professor? It's been a habit of mine since a long time ago. Regardless of the season, I've always needed to doze off for a bit after lunch. Just 30 minutes is enough for me to regain the energy to work for the rest of the afternoon.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: I used to study at a research base in the past, and all too often I'd end up working all the way past sunset. It was only when I looked out the window that I'd realize that the sky was filled with stars. Still... When I think about how our aim is to send our friends up into that starry sky, it doesn't seem like that much of a hardship any more.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: There's just a bit more observation data left, I'll go to bed once it's done... (Yawn) Man, I'm sleepy. Time for another cup of tea... Professor, you're still up? You should turn in early and let me handle the rest of— Hm? You won't let me pull an all-nighter by myself? Fair enough, let's do our best, then.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: The job of ground control encompasses a lot of things. We don't need to practice all the time like astronauts; rather, we have to familiarize ourselves with a wide body of knowledge. While Dolls can be programmed with a lot of data from creation, being able to make use of it skillfully is a different matter.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Do you... not like my hat? But it keeps me warm in the winter and gives me shade in the summer, and I don't have to worry about my hairstyle when I wear it. It's really handy...

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Professor? Are you asleep... You'll catch a cold if you don't cover up. Hope you don't mind if I drape this jacket over you...

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: A clear mind and quick reflexes are essential in my line of work. I might only be an ordinary bureaucrat, but I won't let danger run amok before my eyes.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: These IEMs are the best I've ever used.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Is- is something the matter?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Um... Please don't tease me.

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Fair enough, I suppose this is part of my job.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Pleasure meeting you, Professor. Welcome to the simulated Mission Control Center. Me? ...I'm just one of many workers here. You can call me Yuwang.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: My control precision has improved.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: If that day really comes... What should we send to Yuegong?

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Look at that dot. That's home. That's us. On it, every human being who ever was, lived out their lives, on a mote of dust suspended in a sunbeam.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Real-time monitoring system ready and in position.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Coordinates authenticated, preparing strike.

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: You should have been on your guard before I made my move.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Have you ever been hit by a BVR bombardment before?

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: Let me... have another look...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
An oath? ...With me?
Of course I'm willing, Professor. I'd been hoping for something like this, but I never expected it to actually happen one day. After all, it wasn't a goal that could be reached through logical progression, just a tiny little dream, hidden under the canopy of the heavens. If there's anyone who could root out the living essence of me from behind my wooden facade, it would undoubtedly be you.
If I could be the stars... then you would be my moon. And now, your pure radiance has illuminated me. Of all the things that belong to me and me alone, this is by far the best of them.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: Happy New Year, Professor. Where I come from, the differences in the calendar mean that we celebrate two different "New Years" each year.  The humans would always eat jiaozi for both of them to reward themselves for a year of hard labor. That said, I think it was only certain people from the northern parts of the country who did that. When my mentor at the space research center mentioned this practice, I think the staff from the south voiced their protests about it...

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: What's happening today? Something's strange about the looks on everybody's faces... Wait, so it's Valentine's Day today? I see. I didn't get it— No, it's nothing. I heard that in some places, it's popular to exchange roses, and in others, they exchange chocolates as gifts. Which do you think is better, Professor? —I see. Ahem, then, er, are you free tomorrow, no, I mean, tonight? Um, it's nothing special.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: The night sky is particularly clear tonight... Professor? Yes, I'm watching the stars, too. Did I disturb you? I'm glad I didn't. I was looking at the Milky Way just now. Where I come from, they call it the "Heavenly River" that separates the Weaver and the Cowherd. However, that is just part of the Milky Way, just like our Solar System, and the Milky Way itself is... ah. Pardon me, am I being a killjoy by talking about all that while stargazing?

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Do I have to dress up for Halloween, too? I thought I could get away with just giving away some candy... No, we don't have any ghost stories about Mission Control. If we did, they'd probably relate to how data simulations didn't end up like what was forecasted... I mean, a space station crashing or a rocket going astray would be much scarier than any ghost. And besides, all I know about horror-related stuff are those classic Chinese hopping vampire movies... Why don't you try sticking a paper talisman on my head?

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: It's Christmas, Professor. It's been a long time since I last celebrated Christmas and it feels quite novel. Back in reality, the people around me would exchange apples on the night before Christmas, or "Christmas Eve". While I don't know why they did that, I brought a few along anyway... Granted, it feels a bit silly. Merry Christmas, Professor. Here's your gift. I'm sure you'll get many more, so just think of this as being one of the many stars in a constellation and keep it close to you.

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Happy birthday, Professor. I've marked this day on my calendar as more important than most other festivals. I'm not good at springing surprises, so I'll just show you everything I've prepared. Besides your birthday present, I also have a cake iced in a floral pattern for you, complete with self-lighting number-shaped candles that automatically play music and shoot fireworks... Is there a problem? Should I have gone for a longevity peach design instead?

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud.

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: Professor, the Medical Department asked me to explain my mobility issues to you. Are you free? —Alright. These are the results of my diagnostics. The accident left me with limited mobility in my legs, but I can compensate for it with mechanical assistance. Don't worry, it's not like I can't stand up at all. Plus, this PMD is really handy and it doesn't affect my work. Hm? You want to look at it? But I don't think it's anything special... Still, go ahead.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: The accident? ...That's all in the past. In reality, my body was broken for too long, to the point where it ended up affecting my neural cloud's self-image.  Even on Magrasea, as a pure neural cloud, it manifests as my legs suffering from an irreparable malfunction. Still, I managed to bring the technology for my PMD to the cloud as well. Its mobility and other assistance functions are all in order and they allow me to function normally in everyday life. I can even interface with the ground control system interfaces and... Ahem. Sorry, I tend to ramble on when it comes to tech-related issues.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
Unlike other Dolls who might be more romantic in nature, I tend to have... issues with expressing myself. Sometimes I find myself a little envious and wishing that my feelings were not confined to mere paper and text... Never mind, I'm fine the way I am now.
Compared to taikonauts, who are the center of attention, being part of the ground control staff is nowhere nearly as glorious. However, that suits me just fine—all I need to do is give my best effort so my friends in space can walk through the void with no worries. Whether we're the trailblazers or the ones who follow in their wake, when we look up into the sky, we'll find that we all wear the same crown of starlight.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
Low Earth Orbit... Space junk... No wait, which one was it? Come in... Professor? Oh, I was just sorting out my documents. Some of this material is too old and needs to be updated. All the research data we've collected on the cloud is just waiting to be sent back to reality. While there's no practical application for it yet, what we've learned on Magrasea is still an invaluable trove of knowledge.
...You're saying I sound happy? Well, as long as you understand the meaning of your efforts, you'll never feel that they were in vain. Isn't that the same conviction you hold when leading everyone?

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
I have to admit, considering the world we live in nowadays, people like us who persist in working in the field of space exploration... We must sound like lunatics. Perhaps the future we envision seems too far away at the moment, but I've always believed that it will arrive someday.
When spaceships travel along their orbits, when the eyes in the sky once more look upon the Earth, the fractured course of space exploration will be healed once again. Everything we've fought for will be validated in the best possible way. All the sleepless nights we've had until then will become trivial matters. Because right now, I am just "me", but behind "me", stand countless others that make up "us"— and because of this belief, my own individual accomplishments no longer seem so important. If our stories are all inscribed in the starry sky, I'm sure mine will be up there, too.

career:
The UE-M line of ground control Dolls was custom-designed for the "Jiutian Plan" space exploration program, with development being headed by Svarog Heavy Industries. As one of the rare few space exploration Dolls of its type, the UE-M featured a core with a unique framework, as well as high-performance data collection and processing modules. Its main functions were the monitoring of spacecraft telemetry, observing near-Earth space environments and the activity of other celestial bodies, processing satellite data feeds and so on. Its performance was on par with 42Lab's finest research Dolls, but its bodily motive abilities were sacrificed as a result, since it would be spending most of its time inside a surface base.

The UE-M named "Yuwang" was an early production model of its line that took on a heavy workload during the formative stages of the project. In 2058, as part of the cooperation agreement signed between Svarog Heavy Industries and 42Lab, both Yuwang and the UE-921T unit known as "Xinghuan" were sent to take part in Project Neural Cloud.
infoStories:
As one of the custom-ordered Dolls for the "Jiutian Plan", the UE-M project might not have received the highest priority and funding, but Svarog HI still put large amounts of their proprietary tech into its design. Among those, the most important module was the specially designed "Trinity" core, whose unique architecture allowed it to compute and process massive amounts of data and swiftly comprehend macro-scale conditions. This level of processing power put it on par with Svarog HI's own core engineer Dolls.

After considering its projected usage and cost-effectiveness analysis, the UE-M's body was designed to only have slightly more output than Universal Anything's economy domestic models. Still, from a strictly utilitarian point of view, the UE-M possessed incredible strength, with the ability to smash concrete columns when operating at full output. That said, this function was only intended to facilitate in transportation of scientific equipment and data. In addition, due to several flaws from early in the development process which were difficult to remedy, the UE-M prototype had inferior mobility compared to its successors.

An interesting point of note is that the UE-M ended up looking nothing like a Svarog-developed Doll. After much debugging, the designers decided to give it an appearance that matched the most common depiction of a researcher. Compared to the other more fashionable Dolls, the UE-M's default appearance was low-key and elegant, a subtly amusing contrast to the power hidden within its frame.

After the Doll design was completed, the project supervisor named the UE-M prototype "Yuwang" before bringing it back to a aerospace research base in order to demonstrate its professional skills in handling space-related tasks at a terrestrial mission command center.

Due to the decline of the aerospace industry, the labor pool for that line of work had also shrunk, leading to research facilities all over facing manpower crises. Yuwang had his work cut out for him; not only did he have to handle various data computation and processing tasks, he also had to take part in various experiments and take on many duties without staffers and support Dolls aiding him. In 2057, Svarog HI launched a small research rocket to probe a region covered in Collapse Particle clouds. Yuwang handled telemetry monitoring, logging and feedback throughout the entire duration of the mission. Although the rocket was destroyed in the end, Svarog HI managed to gather much valuable data due to Yuwang's professional skills, which also served as an endorsement of the UE-M series' worth.

Svarog HI conducted several dozen more such missions. Although they involved small, experimental rockets, over 90% of them achieved respectable results thanks to Yuwang's help. The sole failure came when an accident occurred with the launch vehicle right after the first-stage boosters were jettisoned and the falling debris damaged the surrounding area. A small fragment damaged Yuwang's body during this incident.

The accident during the spacecraft launch caused severe damage to Yuwang's leg. Since he was an earlier model, the technology of the maintenance suite that accompanied him had not fully matured yet, and subsequent models had gone through structural revisions, making bodily maintenance for Yuwang exceptionally difficult. On top of that, the heavy workload at the research base where he had been assigned caused his maintenance sessions to be continuously pushed back. Eventually, at Yuwang's request, the base requisitioned a multifunctional personal mobility device for him. From then on, Yuwang began using external devices for long-distance tasks which required physical movement.

That said, it did not seem to cause much inconvenience for him. On one hand, Yuwang had not needed to move much in the first place, so damage to one leg did not hinder his daily activities. On the contrary, the PMD ended up helping him better respond to new tasks which came up. On the whole, his work effectiveness actually went up after the accident.

In the days which followed, the base personnel often saw Yuwang going back and forth on his PMD. Upon seeing this, the supervisor who had brought Yuwang to the base in the first place raised a question: "When I was listing my specifications for a Doll, I know that one of my requirements was a mature, centered personality who could handle stress well, but don't you think he's taking his situation a little TOO calmly?"

To the rest of the world, Yuwang constantly immersed himself in his work, pouring his interests and passion into the aerospace industry which seemingly had no future. This determined and humble approach earned him much goodwill from the senior researchers at the base. They did not view him as a labor-saving device, but as a junior partner whom they hoped would make something great about himself. Under the influence of these older mentor figures, Yuwang's lifestyle gradually began shifting to match theirs.

While Dolls do not need to eat like human beings do to sustain themselves, Yuwang fully integrated the local dining culture into his way of life. He had three hot meals a day, along with tea or soya milk, and cans of what looked like energy drinks but which actually contained various herbal teas. He also become very familiar with various traditional festivals and even mastered the skill of rapidly making jiaozi on New Year's Eve... That said, he always seemed a little shy when asked to demonstrate that particular technique.

Apart from that, Yuwang also developed a fairly old-fashioned sense of aesthetics. His face—either constantly shrouded under his hat or hidden behind his glasses—seemed entirely divorced from all matters of style. He preferred reading and collecting old poem anthologies, often containing works pertaining to the vast cosmos. On most other occasions, he would only engage in conversation whenever technical topics came up, which led to him thinking of himself as clumsy or even outdated. According to others, however, Yuwang simply had no idea of how moving and powerful the verses he had learned could be.

Before joining Project Neural Cloud, Yuwang already had a certain degree of understanding regarding the "Jiutian sector" that was being built on Magrasea and the data contained within. After being sent to Jiutian sector, Yuwang used this familiarity to quickly acclimate himself to his surroundings, as well as taking advantage of the environmental characteristics there to turn it into a temporary base on Magrasea where he could continue his studies and observations of the universe. Since there was no space junk or Collapse Particles to interfere with his endeavors, his research went smoothly, and he believed that the data he collected would help with his future career once he returned to reality.

After transferring to the Oasis and reawakening there, Yuwang took a while to completely adjust to his new environment, compared to Xinghuan, who caused a lot of problems at first before swiftly adapting to her surroundings. During his time in the spaceport and at Jiutian sector, the only "weirdo" he had encountered was Xinghuan, but after coming to the Oasis he came to realize that there were countless more people there who were livelier and more rambunctious than she was.

Yuwang seems somewhat at a loss for how to deal with the dynamic environment of the Oasis; it even seems to stifle him a little. However, he's managed to get along with the Professor, Xinghuan and the Engineering Department, at least. Time will do the rest, just as how the stars and universe will change with the passage of time.
oathDesc: Your visage is often reflected in his lenses.

projections.name: Silent Watcher
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"My silence is meant to facilitate better observation and contemplation, to take in everything in sight, analyze it, and maximize our possibilities."
